key_insight: Visual generation should shift from pure appearance synthesis to 'intelligent' generation: models that produce plausible visuals grounded in structure, dynamics, domain knowledge, and causal relations, captured by a five-level taxonomy from atomic mapping to agentic world modeling.
problem_solved: Addresses limits of current visual generative models — weak spatial reasoning, lack of persistent state and long-horizon consistency, and poor causal understanding — by providing a framework and roadmap to build visually plausible, structured, and interactive world models.
method: Define a five-level taxonomy that traces capability evolution (atomic appearance mapping → structured object/scene representations → dynamics & temporal coherence → knowledge- and causality-aware models → agentic world modeling).
Evaluate existing models against this taxonomy to highlight capability gaps (spatial, temporal, causal, persistent state).
Propose research directions and design priorities: structured representations, dynamic simulation, causal learning, memory/persistence, and agentic planning for interactive generation.
impact: Provides a clear conceptual roadmap for researchers and practitioners to prioritize building generation systems that are not only photorealistic but also spatially coherent, persistent over time, and capable of reasoning and interaction — enabling more reliable editing, simulation, and embodied AI applications.
visual_elements: Five-level taxonomy diagram (stack or ladder) showing progression from atomic mapping to agentic world modeling with capability labels per level.
Before/after example panels: traditional appearance-only output vs. structure- and dynamics-aware output (e.g., object permanence across frames).
Capability gap radar chart comparing current models to desired properties (spatial reasoning, persistence, temporal consistency, causality, interactivity).
Agent–world loop schematic illustrating memory, planning, simulation, and visual generation components in an agentic world model.
paper_title: Visual Generation in the New Era: An Evolution from Atomic Mapping to Agentic World Modeling
paper_authors: Keming Wu, Zuhao Yang, Kaichen Zhang, Shizun Wang, Haowei Zhu
